name: combobox
summary: The keyboard half of a text field with a list of suggestions; focus never leaves the field.

option.doc: One per suggestion; a hidden or disabled one is skipped.

active.doc: The marked option's index among those showing; -1 for none.

activeId.doc: The marked option's own id, for aria-activedescendant.

hide.doc: Closes the list and clears the mark.
